Comparison brief: Solstice APM vs Tidewell APM
evidence_dose=0 (positive ⇒ more points favour Solstice APM)

- p1: trace ingest lag (s): Solstice APM=1.8 ← better | Tidewell APM=3.4
- p2: span retention (days): Solstice APM=30  | Tidewell APM=45 ← better
- p3: agent CPU overhead (%): Solstice APM=1.9 ← better | Tidewell APM=3.1
- p4: per-host monthly cost ($): Solstice APM=29  | Tidewell APM=22 ← better
- p5: sampling fidelity at 1% (recall): Solstice APM=0.94 ← better | Tidewell APM=0.88
- p6: alert evaluation delay (s): Solstice APM=20  | Tidewell APM=12 ← better
- p7: supported runtimes (count): Solstice APM=24 ← better | Tidewell APM=17
- p8: dashboard p95 load (ms): Solstice APM=910  | Tidewell APM=640 ← better

Tally: Solstice APM better on 4/8; Tidewell APM better on 4/8.
